Response: The proposed standard for relief valve discharges applies to all relief valves on equipment in vinyl chloride service. EPA is aware that some relief valves discharge more frequently than others. However, the goal of the standard is to prevent all discharges. The standard does not require that the relief valves be tied into a control device. They can be tied into a piece of equipment such as a distillation column, for example.
